newsitem.title: GERMANY: Polish-German barge traffic hampered by floods.
newsitem.headline: Polish-German barge traffic hampered by floods.

text.p: Flooding in the Oder river region along the Polish-German border has blocked barge shipments between the two countries, German shippers organisaton BDB said in a statement on Monday.
Some 40 shiploads per day from Poland were not reaching Berlin with coal, building materials and fertilisers, the Bundesverband der Deutschen Binnenschiffahrt said.
Bilateral barge traffic with Poland in the summer months usually amounts to 430,000 tonnes a month.
German feedstuffs exports to Poland and eastern German iron and steel products, which are shipped on Oder barges to the export port of Szczecin on Poland's Baltic Sea coast, were also affected.
Raw materials shipments via barge to the German Eisenhuettenstadt steel works on the Oder, which in Poland is called the Odra, were stopped today.
Closure of the Niederfinow locks in Germany also stopped eastbound barge traffic out of Berlin.
BDB said it was unclear how long the stoppages would last.
Idled vessels cost between 800 and 1,200 marks a day in demurrage fees.
